commits.message:
refactor(settings): an option's label is a facet of its domain (brandon-menus-sjhy.pyt)

Every picker over variations or shades now marks trials, not just the
settings menu's own. Authored labels had no caller, so they go with
their loader, schema and cross-ref checks.
feat(settings): a setting has one list, and an option's label is separate from its value (brandon-menus-sjhy.pyt)

feat(effect): the wheel turns each segment at a pace set by where it sits (brandon-menus-sjhy.ju8)

The wheel lives in rich-js, and 0.27.0 reads a segment's place from the
frame it is handed, so moving to it is the feature and the row wrapping
here does not change.

0.27.0's Palette is built from a total set of roles, so paletteRole's
undefined branch cannot run. paletteRole, DecorRole and ThemePole go, and
so do the two tests of a palette that can no longer be built.

test(protocol): the glyph clip is pinned by the one table both runtimes assert (brandon-unfiled-3248.1izo) (#526)

* test(protocol): the glyph clip is pinned by the one table both runtimes assert (brandon-unfiled-3248.1izo)

What the clip does to a string is behaviour, and either runtime could change it, update its own hand-mirrored test, and leave the other unaware. The shared fixture now carries clip cases, so a clip rule changed in one runtime fails the other's test. The Rust clip takes its budget as a parameter so those cases can drive it.

The mirrored tests were also the only proof a message reaches the clip, so each runtime keeps one test that every message-bearing cause clips at the budget, with the expected text derived from the clip itself.

* docs(protocol): the glyph header names the one table that pins the clip (brandon-unfiled-3248.1izo)

* test(protocol): each message-bearing cause's whole glyph is in the one table (brandon-unfiled-3248.1izo)

The wiring tests kept after the clip moved to the table were a hand-mirrored pair of their own: each runtime spelled the four labels, an all-x message could not tell a real clip from a UTF-16 or byte slice, and expected text derived from the constant left the budget's value unpinned. A row per cause with an astral message and the exact bytes closes all three, and replaces the wiring pair and the short-message tests. The budget constant goes back to private: nothing outside its module names it now.

* test(protocol): every permanent cause's glyph text is in the one table (brandon-unfiled-3248.1izo)

version_mismatch was still a hand-mirrored pair, the defect this branch removes for the clip, so a row is now one outcome and its text and the table covers every cause. The style envelope comes out of the rows: check-protocol already owns it, and four copies of it in a fixture were a third place to edit. The combining-mark row is spelled with escapes, because a normalizing editor would silently change what it tests.
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a slider
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a control, and starts larger
feat(site): site:dev serves the live bar and reloads it on every rebuild
